decisions.reason: Visibility grew from a mention to a dedicated page and the product is close to the core geospatial security offer, so it is a cheap option worth keeping open while its value becomes clear.

The open framework fits the firm's open, extensible component strategy and costs little to keep, but it has stayed at the level of a website mention, so its prospects are still uncertain rather than shown to be poor.

Promotion moved to a dedicated page with a more specific integration message, which signals growing commitment to a product that integrates GIS with enterprise user management, in line with the firm's direction.
Launched only in 2024, this low-cost consulting workshop builds on existing know-how and feeds project business, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and abandoning it would be premature.
